newsitem.title: JAPAN: Arai-Gumi"s "96 current profit seen lower -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Arai-Gumi"s "96 current profit seen lower -- paper.

text.p: Construction company Arai-Gumi Ltd is expected to post a parent current profit of about 2.4 billion yen for the year to December 31, 1996, down 51 percent from a year earlier, a business daily said on Wednesday.
The expected lower profit is due to worsening profitability as a result of severe competition and rising losses on loans to its customers, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Arai-Gumi declined to comment on the Nihon Keizai report but said that it would announce its earnings later this month.
At 0055 GMT, shares in Arai-Gumi were down 30 yen at 687 yen on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
